assumptions: Empirical marginal 5th and 95th percentiles are provisional exploratory bounds, not validated economic uncertainty ranges.
Inputs are sampled independently; combinations can violate historical economic dependencies and are not equally likely future states.
The distribution of scenario-level GaR outcomes is not a calibrated predictive probability distribution.
The fitted quantile-regression coefficients are fixed across scenarios; the existing predict method refits only the conditional T-skew distribution from scenario-specific conditional quantiles.
